profile.name: DXP软触发组件
profile.description: 用于 DXP/MCA 采集系统的非实体软件触发组件。它在实验中负责为关联的 EPICS DXP 设备准备软触发采集流程、设置预设计数相关信号，并在进入 stage 时整理采集时间等阶段参数。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software trigger component for DXP/MCA acquisition systems. In laboratory use, it prepares soft-triggered acquisition for associated EPICS DXP devices, configures preset counting-related signals, and organizes staged acquisition parameters such as count time during staging.

registry.name: Soft DXP Trigger
registry.description: XIA软件数字脉冲处理器(DXP)触发控制模块，用于X射线荧光探测器。
